reset_parameters_module: reset the parameters and buffers of a PyTorch module and its descendants
reset_non_persistent_buffers_module: reset the non-persistent buffers of a PyTorch module and its descendant modules
visit_module_with_visitor: run a visitor function on a PyTorch module and optionally its descendant modules
to_device_module: move the parameters and buffers of a PyTorch module to a target device
broadcast_module_gang: broadcast a PyTorch module to all processes in a distributed gang
